stories.headline: Mel Gibson reveals 2-part 'Passion of the Christ' sequels will be in English, told in non-linear style
stories.summary: Director Mel Gibson has shared fresh details regarding the cinematic continuation of his 2004 film about Jesus' final hours. Divided across two installments, the upcoming project will feature English dialogue and unfold through a non-chronological storyline. This structural direction represents a noticeable creative evolution from the original faith-based blockbuster.
